isatvon_definition.i_instructions: Triggered by the Dify DMR's POST /tool/execute for skill_index 2 of Standard_BOM_Flow, after a QuoteWin (Awards Part Number Listing) file is uploaded via upload_server.py's POST /api/rfq/upload/quotewin. Action: validate rfq_id, resolve the registered QuoteWin file path from rfq_file_telemetry (file_role='QUOTEWIN'), run process_quote_win() to map/standardize the workbook, and write the standardized rows to DuckDB's quote_win table under a cross-process lock. Check: rfq_id format guard, and the write result reports status=='success'. Bound: single attempt only -- no retry loop exists; unlike Costing Sheet/ERP, QuoteWin is a REQUIRED input for this tool -- a missing file is a hard failure (status:'failed'), not a graceful skip. Business rule: schema mapping and standardization only, no downstream cbom/enrichment logic performed here.

required_inputs: A row in file_metadata_db.rfq_file_telemetry with file_role='QUOTEWIN', is_active=true, for (rfq_id, version) -- required, no graceful-skip path if missing
fresh_state_parameters: version (integer, default 1, resolved by fastapi_router.py's active-version lookup before this tool is called)

a_automation.action_step: Fetch the QuoteWin file path via postgres_metadata__execute_sql, run process_quote_win(quote_win_file), then write the resulting DataFrame to DuckDB's quote_win table inside db.duckdb_file_lock().
a_automation.acceptance_check: Programmatically evaluate whether the write result's status=='success'.

t_tech_stack.action_tool: standardize_quote_win (this tool itself, plus process_quote_win / process_quote_win_to_database helper functions)
t_tech_stack.fixed_check_tool: None -- no independent validation MCP tool exists; validation is inline (_validate_id(), status check on the single table write).

v_variables.no_op_condition: already_processed==true if quote_win rows already exist for this rfq_id+version -- same idempotency pattern as standardize_scrub_bom, but this tool never sets hitl itself either way
v_variables.escalation_condition: None specific to this tool -- it never sets hitl:1 on its own response; it exists to clear the FRESH-scrub_bom-triggered HITL pause by being uploaded, then the caller (RfqErpQuoteWinUploadModal.tsx) calls GET /api/dify/start to resume
v_variables.budget_limit: 300s MCP Jungle call_tool() timeout / 600s Dify HTTP node timeout -- same real, unsynced values as standardize_scrub_bom

o_outcome.state_handoff_file: No dedicated append-only audit table exists. Real state handoff is the written quote_win DuckDB rows, plus PostHog upload_processing_started/completed/failed events. Flagged as a gap against ISATVON's audit-artifact expectation.

ui_updates: Generic {skillCode:'M03.2_QuoteWinStandardize', skillName:'Standardize QuoteWin Report', stepStatus} pushed via fastapi_router.py's notify_skill_progress() -- running before the call, completed/failed after
database_updates: file_metadata_db.rfq_process_tracking.rfq_process_stage incremented by fastapi_router.py when this tool succeeds (hitl falsy)
alerts: None confirmed beyond the SSE progress events

persistence.database: DuckDB (input_db.duckdb) for output; PostgreSQL file_metadata_db for file-path lookup
persistence.action: Direct DuckDB write under db.duckdb_file_lock(); Postgres file-path read via postgres_metadata__execute_sql MCP tool

ui.method: SSE push via the daemon's rfq:skill-progress channel
